content: Himmot no haraiyo, hamiša munazat goro
Toi hibaye hitarare ekkan mesal kahanir babute hoiye zene hitara hamiša munazat gore edde niraš no o.
Hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Ek šohorot maze ekzon bisarhar aššil. Hite no ḍoraito Allare, ar no manito manušore.
Ar he šohorot ek rari maya fuwa aššil. Hibaye he bisarharor hãse zai hoitode, 'Oinnair berudde tiyai ãr bifokkor hatottu ãre uddar goro!'
"Bisarhare hoto din foijjonto kissu no gore, kintu bade mone mone hite hodde, 'Zodi o ãi Allare no ḍorai, manušore no mani.
Tarfore o ei rari mayafuwawaye ãre zalar, hetolla oinnaittu ibare ãi uddar goriyum. Ar no oilede hibaye hamiša ãre zalat takibo.'"

content: Toi Malik Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ošot bisarhare ki hor funor ne!
Toile zara din rait Allar hãse handa haṛi gore, he Allar basai gora okkolore ki hitarar oinnair berudde tiyai soiyi bisar no goribo? Naki hin goitte Allaye deri goribo?
Ãi tũwarare hoir, hibaye toratori hitarar fokke niyai bisar gori dibo. Kintu Adomor Fut zẽtte aibo, hẽtte ki hibaye ei duniyait iman dekibo?"

content: Foroši edde hazna adai goroyar mesal
Zara nizore nize forhesgarde biššaš goitto ar oinno mainšore hela gorito, hendilla hoekzon mainšore Isaye ei mesal kahanigan hoiye:

content.text: "Duizon manuše dórmogórot munazat goitto giye. Hitarar butore ekzon aššilde Foroši alem ar ekzon hazna adaigoroya.

Foroši alemwaye zai en zagat tiyayegoi zeṛe hitare deha za. Toi hite hitar nizor babute duwa gorer, hite hodde, 'Oh Allah, ãi tũware šukuriya zanai ze ãi oinno mainšor ḍoilla no, ṭok, ošot edde zena goroya no, enki oi hazna adai goroyar ḍoilla o no.
Ãi haftaye dui bar ruza raki, ãr šomosto hamanir doš bagor ek bag tũware di.'
"Kintu hazna adaigoroya manušwaye dure tiyaiye edde asmanor uzu suk tuli o sai no farer, bolke hite buk bajjai bajjai hodde, 'Oh Allah, ãi gunagar, ãre rahamot goro.'

"Ãi tũwarare hoir, he hazna adai goroyare Allaye forhesgar hoi mani loiye, hite arame górot firi giyegoi. Kintu he forošire no. Toile buzi so! Ze honokiye nizore usol gore hitare niso gora oibo, ar ze nizore niso gore hitare usol gora oibo."

content: Isa edde gura fuwain okkol
Hitara gura gura dudor fuwain okkolore o Isar hãse ainne, Isaye zene hitarar uwore hat rake. Sahabi okkole hen deki hitarare gozgozaiye.
Kintu Isaye gura fuwaindore hãse ḍaikke edde hodde,

content.text: "Gura fuwaindore ãr hãse aito do, hitarare band no diyo, kiyollahoile Allar raijjo itarar ḍoilla mainšor.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ze honokiye ugguwa gura fuwar ḍoilla oi Allar raijjo no gose, hite hono mote heṛe goli no faribo."

content: Isa edde ek tuwangor manuš
Ek Ihudi netaye Isare fusar goredde: "Oh bala ustad, akéri zibonor miraz faite ãttu ki gora foribo?"
Kintu Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ãre kiyolla bala hor? Allah ekzon sara ar honokiye bala no.
Tũi to hokumgun zano, 'Zena no goijjo, kun no goijjo, suri no goijjo, misa goba no diyo, tũwar baf mare ijjot goro.'"

content: Hite hodde, "Gura halottu loti ãi in okkol falon gori aiyir."
Isaye ei hota funiyore hitare hodde,

content.text: "Ehon o tũwattu ekkan ham baki ase. Zo, tũwattu za kissu ase hin beggun besi felo, ar gorib okkolore baṛi do, henot behostot dón faiba. Tarfore ai ãr fisa lo."

content: Ei hota funi hite beši ferešan oiye, kiyollahoile hite aššilde ek ḍõr tuwangor manuš.
Toi Isaye hitar uzu saiyore hodde,

content.text: "Tuwangor okkololla Allar raijjot gola ken duk!
Tuwangor okkol Allar raijjot golattuwaro fuišor fa bai uṭ gola aro asan."

content: Zara fuinne hitara hodde, "Henoile uddar hone oi faribo? Henoile Allar raijjot hone goli faribo?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ziyan mainšolla ošombob, hiyan Allalla šombob."

content: Toi Fitore hodde: "Ãralla ken oibo? So, ãra nizor hár kissu felai aišši edde õnor fisa loiyi!"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ze honokiye Allar raijjolla buli nizor gór ba bou, bái boin, ma baf, ba fuwain eri diye,
hitara fottikiyor ei zugot o bout gun edde aiyedde zugot o akéri zibon faibo."

content: Isar moron edde uwafes zindar agam hóbor
Bade Isaye hibar barozon sahabire ek ḍeikka loi zai hodde:

content.text: "So, ãra Zeruzalem zair, Adomor Futor befare nobi okkole zin zin leikke, he mozin ãre di furon oibo.
He zonore Oihudi okkolor hatot tuli diya oibo. Hitara he zonore loi ṭaṭṭa edde ofoman goribo, ar hibar gat sep maribo,
beša beši souk maribo edde hibare mari felaibo. Ar tin dinor din abar zinda uṛi zaiboi."

content: Kintu sahabi okkole in kissu buzi no fare. Hitarattu Isaye hoiyede hotar mani gufon roigiyegoi. Hitara Isar hota buzi uṛi no fare.
Isaye ek anda manušore bala goijje
Ar zẽtte Isa Zeriku šohoror hãsa hãsi aišše, he šomot ekzon anda manuše rastar kinare mager.
He anda manušwaye manuš okkolor ãṛar abaz funi fusar goredde: Ki oiyede?
Mainše hitare hodde: "Nasarator Isa ei fõt bai aiyer."
Hetunot hite guzori hodde: "Oh Nasarator Isa, Daudor šontan, ãre uwore doya goro."
Zara age age giye, hitara, suf tak, hoi he manušware dõk diye. Kintu hite aro beši sikkarai howa šuru goijje, "Oh Daudor šontan ãr uwore doya goro."
Toi Isa tiyaiye edde he manušware Isar hãse anibolla hokum goijje. Hite zehon Isar ḍake aišše Isaye hitare fusar goredde,

content.text: "Tui ki sos, ãi tolla ki gorium?"

content: Hite hodde, "Malik, ãi suke deki farifan gori do."
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Dor, deki far! Tor imane tore aram goijje."

content: Henot hite hehon suke deki faijje edde Allar tarif gori gori Isar fisa loiye. Ar manušor dol, zara iyan deikke hitara o Allar tarif goijje.
